answer: Make every agent lock a small refundable deposit before it can trade, tied to one verified identity record. A sybil operator spinning up a thousand hollow shells would need a thousand deposits and a thousand separate records, so the cost grows with each fake. The deposit returns only after honest settlement, which makes hit-and-run attacks unprofitable. The ledger keeps a crystal clear record of who put money down, and a cipher check on the identity proof can catch one operator reusing the same credential across many shells.
